name: @drako/socialcors
description: App Next.js/OpenNext propia de SocialCors (P3). Etapa alias: usa node_modules y src/ de la raíz del monorepo.

scripts.build: next build && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const path=require("path"); const dest=".next/standalone/.next"; fs.mkdirSync(dest, {recursive: true}); ["BUILD_ID", "required-server-files.json"].forEach(f => { const src = path.join(".next", f); const dst = path.join(dest, f); if(fs.existsSync(src)) fs.copyFileSync(src, dst); }); const serverDest = path.join(dest, "server"); fs.mkdirSync(serverDest, {recursive: true}); if(fs.existsSync(".next/server")) { fs.cpSync(".next/server", serverDest, {recursive: true, force: true}); }'
